channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Long-term melatonin use tied to higher heart failure risk
item.description: Chronic insomnia patients using melatonin long-term had a 90% higher risk of heart failure over five years, a study found.

item.title: Universe's expansion still accelerating, new analysis confirms
item.description: A major analysis challenges claims of slowing expansion, reinforcing evidence for cosmic acceleration.

item.title: Scientists convert hard-to-recycle PVC into high-performance engine lubricant
item.description: A new method turns PVC, a notoriously difficult plastic to recycle, into a key ingredient for high-performance lubricants.

item.title: Australia's red soil may hide a vast clean energy source
item.description: Iron-rich rocks in Western Australia can naturally generate hydrogen, and researchers say the process could be enhanced for large-scale production.
